author: NorthEast News Desk
body: An MBTA bus was involved in a multi-vehicle crash on the Fellsway in Medford on Thursday morning, prompting a large emergency response and sending the bus driver to a hospital.

WHDH reported that several vehicles were involved and that the collision knocked down a pole. A person near the scene told the station she could see the driver through a window and believed the driver appeared unconscious. Emergency crews later transported the driver for medical care.

Officials had not released the driver’s condition, the number of other people injured or the circumstances leading to the crash when the initial report was published. The MBTA bus route involved also was not immediately identified.

The collision could affect traffic while investigators document the scene and crews address the damaged pole and vehicles. Drivers using the Fellsway should expect possible delays and follow local police directions. Because the response remained active, early details may change as Medford police, fire officials and the MBTA provide additional information. The cause of the crash remains under investigation, and no conclusion about fault has been announced.
dek: Several vehicles were involved in the Thursday morning collision on the Fellsway, where a utility pole was knocked down.
headline: MBTA bus crash in Medford sends driver to hospital
